title: Claude Haiku 4.5 added for text, images, and tools
summary:
Claude Haiku 4.5 joined the model list while a solo fantasy RPG and seven community projects brought more things to explore.

Claude Haiku 4.5 was added as `claudyclaude`, with text and image input plus tool support. An existing model’s input limit rose from 10,000 to 30,000 characters, and text-generation parameter ranges now pass through to downstream APIs for validation.

codevector-2003 added AI Dungeon Master, a React and Vite fantasy RPG with generated story scenes and images, custom actions, dice-based combat, inventory, and browser saves.

Seven projects joined the showcase, spanning thumbnail and image creation, API demos, an iOS Shortcut, browser-based agent tools, and BeeCoder’s VS Code Copilot connection. BeeCoder was also added to the vibe-coding project list.
